(b) At STATION.pour [94,-190] with POUR_CARRIAGE -180, the held crucible spans about x 56 to 132, y -208 to -144 upright. At full tilt (about 47.70 to 48.33) its base end reaches about x 49. After tipping back to pourBack [60,-188] it rests over the left column in the closing frame. (c) The outgoing bent bar and the new bin shelf (anvil+8 to binX+40) cross the right column (x 197 to 215) at anvil height.
